want: to manually set which budget line a transaction on the Transaction List counts toward
soThat: a transaction the automatic wallet, category, and pattern rules get wrong still ends up on the right line without me editing that line's pattern
acceptance: each transaction row in the Transaction List has a Budget cell showing its assigned line or Auto
double-clicking the Budget cell opens a dropdown of every active budget line plus an Auto option, and choosing one persists to Supabase
